definitions.explanation: The part of the body between the chest and the pelvis. A formal or medical term for the stomach/belly area.

examples.japanese: {腹部|ふくぶ}に{痛|いた}みを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel pain in my abdomen.

examples.japanese: {腹部|ふくぶ}のエコー{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had an abdominal ultrasound examination.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{腹部|ふくぶ}を{強|つよ}く{打|う}って{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれた。
examples.english: He was taken to the hospital after hitting his abdomen hard in an accident.

notes:
Compound of {腹|ふく} (belly, abdomen) + {部|ぶ} (part, region). A formal and medical term for the belly area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹部|ふくぶ}の{痛|いた}み: abdominal pain
- {腹部|ふくぶ}{検査|けんさ}: abdominal examination
- {腹部|ふくぶ}エコー: abdominal ultrasound
- {腹部|ふくぶ}CT: abdominal CT scan
- {腹部|ふくぶ}を{刺|さ}す: to stab the abdomen

REGISTER:
Primarily used in medical, formal, and written contexts. In everyday conversation, お{腹|なか} (tummy, stomach area) or {腹|はら} (belly) would be more natural.

RELATED TERMS:
- {胸部|きょうぶ}: chest area
- {背部|はいぶ}: back area
- {下腹部|かふくぶ}: lower abdomen
